ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 40
   C. 30
   D. 75

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

3. Solve for x: x + 6 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 9
   C. 6
   D. 15

4. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/2

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 31
   C. 27
   D. 17

7. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

8. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 28
   C. 3
   D. 29

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 55
   C. 16
   D. 32

10. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 37
   D. 36

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

13. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

14. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

15. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

16. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 9
   D. 21

17. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 12.5
   D. 6

18. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

19. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

20. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 81

21. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

22. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 12

23. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 48
   C. 2
   D. 14

24. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 6
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

25. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 65
   C. 0
   D. 16

26. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 50

27. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

28. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

29. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 81

30. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.7
